entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: I am the miracle merchant! The savior of[n]those who are ill!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Joker, try talking to him! I'm sure he'll[n]change his heart if he hears what we[n]have to say!
By holding up the enemy, you will be able[n]to have a conversation with the target.
By choosing the correct answers, you[n]will be able to change the target's heart.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Time for a miracle! Miracle X!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What!? Did he just heal!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You might call it a miracle, but some[n]people are getting even sicker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: That's their own damn fault! They need[n]to take better care of themselves!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: I've gotten word from people who had[n]the drink saying that they're all better[n]now!
They're fake.
10,000 yen is too expensive.
The drink didn't heal them.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Their illnesses weren't cured by the[n]ingredients in the drink.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Shut up! They were all cured, right!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: You have to believe for it to work!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince him![n]We'll have to try a different approach!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: If it didn't work, then why would people[n]still be buying it!?
You're forcing them to.
It's an automatic renewal.
You're undercharging them.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I heard that you have the clients sign a[n]self-renewing contract?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If you were confident in the authenticity[n]of your products, you wouldn't have to[n]do something like that.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Wh-What? That's just so customers don't[n]have to keep ordering them manually!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Why don't they just cancel their[n]subscription if they don't want it?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: I'm gonna sue you for defamation!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince him![n]We'll have try a different approach!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: The amount of cancellations made by[n]customers is super low! It's 'cause miracles[n]happen if you keep drinking it!
I read the fine print.
Miracles don't happen.
It's just an excuse.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You don't allow them to cancel the renewal[n]because of a loophole, right? People feel like[n]they can't fight back, so they just give up.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you have any proof that it causes[n]miracles?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Uh, proof...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Ugh! Stop nagging! Just try drinking it,[n]then we'll see who's complaining!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince him![n]We'll have to try a different approach!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: I use healthy fruits and vegetables and...[n]There's tons of vitamins in the drink!
There's no scientific proof.
It's just a mixed drink.
It's fake.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You trick sick people by only showing[n]them the successful data right?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: There's nothing wrong with a healthy[n]drink. It's you who needs to be brought[n]to justice!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Ugh...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Food becomes cells, bones, and muscles...[n]In other words, we are what we eat.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If you can't show your customers any[n]sincerity, then you have no right to sell[n]them food! You should be ashamed!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Rgh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: All you're doing is talking shit!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince him![n]We'll have to try a different approach!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: I'm... sorry.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: You can't talk to him!
